requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个串口与本地按键双输入控制系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、LED D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 本地开灯，D3 本地关灯；串口也支持 LIGHT_ON、LIGHT_OFF、BEEP 和 COUNT_RESET 命令；数码管显示累计操作次数。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Send serial frames with io_5_valid=true and io_5=6 (LIGHT_ON), then step without valid; keep io_0=false and io_1=false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 becomes true on the LIGHT_ON step and remains true until a subsequent LIGHT_OFF command or local D3 rising edge.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个串口与本地按键双输入控制系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、LED D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 本地开灯，D3 本地关灯；串口也支持 LIGHT_ON、LIGHT_OFF、BEEP 和 COUNT_RESET 命令；数码管显示累计操作次数。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply local D2 button press as a rising edge on io_0 (io_0 goes false->true), with io_1=false; then hold io_0=true for one step and release to false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On the rising edge step, io_2 becomes true and io_4 increments by 1; holding/releasing without a new rising edge does not change io_4.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个串口与本地按键双输入控制系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、LED D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 本地开灯，D3 本地关灯；串口也支持 LIGHT_ON、LIGHT_OFF、BEEP 和 COUNT_RESET 命令；数码管显示累计操作次数。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply local D3 button press as a rising edge on io_1 (io_1 goes false->true), with io_0=false; then release.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On the rising edge step, io_2 becomes false and io_4 increments by 1; release does not change io_2 or io_4.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个串口与本地按键双输入控制系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、LED D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 本地开灯，D3 本地关灯；串口也支持 LIGHT_ON、LIGHT_OFF、BEEP 和 COUNT_RESET 命令；数码管显示累计操作次数。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: First cause at least one local press rising edge to make io_4>0; then send serial frame with io_5_valid=true and io_5=3 (COUNT_RESET); then one step with io_5_valid=false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: On COUNT_RESET step, io_4 becomes 0 immediately and stays 0 until the next local rising edge increments it.

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 设计一个串口与本地按键双输入控制系统，使用按钮 D2、按钮 D3、LED D13、蜂鸣器 D6 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。D2 本地开灯，D3 本地关灯；串口也支持 LIGHT_ON、LIGHT_OFF、BEEP 和 COUNT_RESET 命令；数码管显示累计操作次数。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Send serial frames with io_5_valid=true and io_5=1 (BEEP) for one step, with io_0=false and io_1=false; then step with io_5_valid=false.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_3 stays 0 (silence) on and after the BEEP command step in this controller model.
